profile: Zevra Therapeutics develops and commercializes medicines for rare diseases. Its marketed products include MIPLYFFA for neurological manifestations of Niemann-Pick disease type C and OLPRUVA for certain urea cycle disorders. The company is conducting a Phase 3 trial of celiprolol for vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome. Zevra sold its rights to AZSTARYS and KP1077 to Commave in 2026.
